ops.body: SYNCKIT SESSION-TYPE FIX BUILT AND GREEN (branch fix/helper-agent-launchd-policy in /tmp/repin-wave/synckit, uncommitted pending review): daemon/service.go:74/:87 route the manifest helper session_type through helperProcessType(); no synckit-emitted agent can carry LimitLoadToSessionType any more. Mapping decision ratified: ONLY Background materializes (as ProcessType Background); Aqua/LoginWindow/StandardIO/System/empty produce nothing — the other domains aren't loadable by a user LaunchAgent, so no intent survives translation. Wire surface unchanged (all five manifest values still validate). New table test TestServiceAgentsNeverSessionLimitHelpers covers all six values incl. rendered-plist substring assertions. Verified under the process-cap wrapper: build/vet/race-test (18 pkgs)/golangci-lint all clean. With this diff, an over-SSH reposync helper install lands as an unrestricted gui-domain agent with ProcessType Background — the deterministic refusal is gone in exactly the context that produced it. Staging half proceeds behind a seam against the provisional daemonkit StableProgramFrom API (see 74be91d7).
